blocks.html: Understanding a rehab length of stay can help you determine whether or not you can afford that much time away from work, family, or other personal responsibilities. Thankfully, there are multiple rehab program length options to fit different schedules and needs.

blocks.html: An inpatient program is where you check into a rehab facility and live at the facility for your program length. This means you have access to specialists and medical professionals 24 hours per day, with a consistent schedule that includes multiple counseling activities, therapies, and activities. Inpatient rehab is often suggested for people who might struggle with painful withdrawal symptoms, co-occurring mental health conditions, or those with a history of relapse.

What Happens After Inpatient Rehab Ends?

blocks.html: Getting answers to questions like “” or “” might help you decide to get treatment, but what happens when your inpatient program ends?
blocks.text: Getting answers to questions like “how long are inpatient programs” or “how long is inpatient rehab” might help you decide to get treatment, but what happens when your inpatient program ends?

blocks.html: It’s pretty standard for rehab facilities to ease your transition into your routine by offering outpatient services or long-term aftercare. This is the next step in your recovery where you no longer live at the treatment center, but you still return to the treatment center for ongoing counseling or individual therapy. Group meetings like AA or NA in your local area are a regular part of this continuous treatment. You get exposure to a network of support of community members and friends going through the same struggle.

blocks.html: The rehab program length for outpatient programs is often significantly longer than for inpatient ones. Depending on your situation, you could receive ongoing therapy and holistic treatment for your addiction for three months, six months, or one year. After returning to your rehab facility for a longer outpatient program length, you might continue your aftercare for the rest of your life, attending local meetings and engaging in sober recreational activities with the support of community members, friends, or family.

How to Find Inpatient Treatment Programs Near Me

blocks.html: If you are ready to find inpatient treatment programs in Dallas, start by inquiring about different rehab program lengths. Don’t be afraid to ask each facility how long their inpatient programs are and whether they have flexible options like 30 days versus 90 days. It’s important to know what program length is most suitable for your personal and professional life. Consider speaking with your HR department about options for taking time off for health conditions. You don’t have to specify drug addiction or mental health conditions; you can make soft inquiries to understand better which program length might suit you.
